simple.meaning: חָנֵף (chânêph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to soil , especially in a moral sense.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 11 times across Numbers, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Daniel, and 1 more, beginning at Numbers 35:33. Its contexts include blood, covenant, Torah, land, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָנֵף (H2610).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָנֵף (chânêph) / H2610 is traced through Numbers 35:33, Psalms 106:38, Isaiah 24:5, Jeremiah 3:1 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to soil , especially in a moral sense
definitions.full: H2610. chaneph [ חָנֵף ] verb polluted, profane (Arabic incline, decline , hence inclining to a right state , but in Hebrew of inclining away from right, irreligion, profaneness , compare have a i.e. distortion of foot ; Syriac in derivatives be profane , etc.; Late Hebrew Hiph`il, Aramaic Aph`el act falsely toward, flatter , חֲנוּפָה hypocrisy ; Assyrian hanpu, ruthlessness; hanâpu, exercise ruthlessness toward, Tel Amarna Zim ZA vi, 1891, 256 ) — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular חָֽנְפָה Isa 24:5 ; 3 plural חָנֵפ֑וּ Jer 23:11 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular תֶּחְֶנַף 3:1 ; תֱּהֶָנ֑ף Micah 4:11 ; וֵתֶּחֱנַף Jer 3:9 ; Psa 106:38 ; Infinitive absolute חָנוֺף Jer 3:1 ; — 1 be polluted: of land Isa 24:5 ; Jer 3:1 (twice in verse); Psa 106:38 ; of Zion Micah 4:11 . 2 of prophet and priest = be חָנֵף (compare below) i.e. profane, godless Jer 23:11 . — apparentlytrans הארץ את וַתֶּחֱנַף , Gf strike out את , Gie cites Ges § 121, 1 , but read rather Hiph`il וַתַּחֲנֵף with Manuscripts ᵐ5 Ew and others (see also Gf. Gie). Hiph`il Imperfect יַחֲנִיף Num 35:33 ; Dan 11:33 ; 2 feminine singular וַתַּחֲנִ֫יפִי Jer 3:2 ; 2 masculine plural תַּחֲנִ֫יפוּ ; — 1 pollute: the land Num 35:33 (twice in verse) (by blood; P), Jer 3:2 (by idolatry, etc.) + 3:9 (see above) 2 make profane, godless Dan 11:32 with accusative of person
